# streamline_consumer_group (Resource)

Retains the legacy `streamline_consumer_group` resource schema for existing state. Consumer groups are created only when application consumers connect, so Terraform cannot create them. Use the `streamline_consumer_group` data source for new configurations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Consumer group identifier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (same as `group_id`).
- `members` (Number) Number of active group members.
- `state` (String) Current broker-reported group state.
